title: maxtek Magnetic Dry Erase Markers with Eraser - 12 Count 10 Colors Fine Tip Whiteboard Markers for Kids, Low Odor Whiteboard Markers for Calendar Boards White Board

reviews.title: Really nice set with a lot of color options, with built in erasers and magnets.
reviews.body: I use these pens at work in my office. Love the color options, some are a little more "fine point" than others that seem a little more like "medium/thick point". But, they work well, and the magnets on the backs of each cap are handy. They stay-put wear you place them (when attached to metal). I use them for important notes, so I don't use the lighter colors (yellow for example) because I want my notes to catch my attention and be reminders. Yellow just doesn't do that for you. But, the lighter colors are fine to be in the pack so that someone can use the pens to color or do art on a wipe board. I've been using the bolder brightest colors daily for about a month or 2, and they are still going strong, so ink consumption has appeared to change or lesson for me.. Oh, and I forgot to mention that the caps also have built-in erasers, so that makes it easy to erase and write something new. You can be precise with the erasers, too, it just takes some practice. The pens are too heavy to hang on a magnetic wipe board. They are compatible with any wipe board, and work especially well on the glass covered one, wear they erase very clean. When writing words, the bright colors are the most readable from a distance.Read moreRead less

reviews.title: Excellent, clear and without residue!
reviews.body: The previous markers that came with the board were getting old, and writing very faint. When it was time to erase them, they left a residue, which was really annoying.I bought these as a replacement and they have a nice fine tip, nice vibrant, color, and erase very easily. The magnet holds them on the fridge nicely, and the eraser and is the perfect size.Though I have not had them long, so far there has been no problem with them drying out, so they have great visibility. Also, I like the colors that are in the set a lot, even better than the original set that came with the board.Read moreRead less

reviews.title: Nice bold colors
reviews.body: I really like the size and the colors that they offer. It’s definitely a value for what you get. I have one disappointment. The red color is the one I expected to be the boldest was actually the weakest. It’s more like a light pink and it definitely does not pop out on a whiteboard. The purple was pretty light as well, but definitely not as bad as the red. Overall, I love the item because the other colors, black, green, blue, orange and the black are very bold and strong in color.  I also like the smaller size.  Erases nice.Read moreRead less

features: Safe, Low-Odor Ink: Certified non-toxic whiteboard markers meet ASTM D-4236 standards, making them safe for both kids and adults.

Get the Richest Color: For the most vibrant and saturated results, we recommend using these markers on a standard porous whiteboard. Please note that on hard, non-porous surfaces like glass, acrylic or blackboard, the ink may lighten and appear less bold.
Reinforced Magnetic Caps: Built-in Reinforced Magnets in Pen Cap, adhesive freely on any metal & magnetic surface; No worry about weak absorption & drop for the magnets on the white board pen.

1-2mm Precise Lines: The fine point dry erase markers work great for writing clearly, making it easier to fill the days on your calendar board/ whiteboard with more information; The marker with a small eraser can be used directly to erase small mistakes.
Vibrant 10 Colors for Highlight and Color Coding: 10 bold colors magnetic whiteboard marker include Blue, orange, brown, red, aubergine, black, green, light blue, dark green, purple.
Fast-drying and Easy to Wipe: The dry erase markers using high-quality German ink, ensure vibrant and long-lasting color expression; Quick dry after writing and are easy to wipe.
Suitable for the non-porous surface: The dry erase markers are magnetic perfect for any magnetic whiteboard, like a fridge whiteboard.
